6.320 rsAggregateInLookupDestinationOrResult
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsAggregateInLookupDestinationOrResult is a critical error that will occur when a Lookup, LookupSet,
or MultiLookup function contains an aggregate function within its Destination or Result function
parameter.
